claimSource.description: VERA Files documented the circulating September 10 graphic claiming that ICC judges rejected the evidence and moved to end Rodrigo Duterte's trial. FMB independently checked the ICC's current case record.

evidence.title: Rodrigo Roa Duterte — ICC case page
evidence.supports: States that Pre-Trial Chamber I unanimously confirmed all three charges on April 23, 2026, committed Duterte to trial, and that the opening of trial is scheduled for November 30, 2026.

evidence.title: ICC Pre-Trial Chamber I confirms all charges against Rodrigo Roa Duterte and commits him to trial
evidence.supports: The April 23, 2026 ICC release says the chamber unanimously confirmed three counts of crimes against humanity and committed Duterte to trial.

evidence.title: FACT CHECK: NO move from ICC judges to end Rodrigo Duterte’s trial
evidence.supports: Documents the circulating graphic and reports the ICC Public Affairs Unit's confirmation that the trial remains scheduled for November 30.

derivedFrom.note: VERA Files supplied the documented research lead for the circulating claim. FMB independently checked the ICC's primary case record before assigning its rating.
